title: Edge parity is invariant under relabeling
statement: For every natural number $v$, the Boolean property of a graph on $v$ vertices that declares the graph to have odd many present edges is invariant under every permutation of the vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is a Boolean encoding of edges on $v$ vertices
The relabeling is a permutation of the vertices
